title: US in possession of exotic material

tellings.quote: it is my uh belief that the United States is in possession of uh of exotic material

plain: The United States holds "exotic material", meaning material of unknown and possibly non-human origin, according to Luis Elizondo, a former Pentagon intelligence official, who tells Michels "it is my belief" in an episode asking whether Oppenheimer worked on UFOs. He offers it as his own belief rather than pointing to a document, and if true, the government would have physical evidence of something it does not acknowledge.
